120799: Nishikata is a middle school student in class 1-2. He sits in the back of the classroom next to Takagi. He can't handle bitter things like black coffee, secretly watches/reads a romance titled "100% Unrequited Love", and gets frightened very easily. He does average academically.
120800: A middle schooler​ at an unnamed school. She sits at the back of class 1-2 next to Nishikata. Academically talented and physically capable, she claims her only weaknesses are her ticklish armpits and her inability to stop teasing Nishikata.
124599: Daughter of Nishikata and (née) Takagi. She hates green peppers, but loves to tickle her father. At the beginning of the story, she goes to kindergarten.
128606: Mano is Nishikata's and Takagi's classmates and has an undisclosed relationship with Nakai. Mano is generally shy, anxious, and sheepish towards other people, especially when she is trying to talk to Nakai.
128607: One of the classmates of Nishikata and Takagi and the boyfriend of Mano. Nakai has a very calm, friendly and laid-back demeanor who enjoys hanging out with his male friends more than he does with Mano.
128608: Mina is an energetic, bubbly girl and always cheerful in the group. She is very playful at all times and always noisy. Mina also is bad at running and gets tired easily, such as when she was excited for the school marathon, yet got tired at the start.
128609: Mr. Tanabe is the homeroom teacher of class 1-2, in which Takagi, Nishikata, Mano, Nakai, Sanae, Mina and Yukari are a part of.
128611: Sanae Tsukimoto is one of Nishikata's and Takagi's classmates and a close friend of Mina and Yukari. Sanae is a very blunt, yet caring and intelligent girl. Known for always having a very stoic expression and demeanor, Sanae likes to keep to herself.
163023: Hamaguchi is one of Nishikata's friend. He seems to be interested in Houjou.
163024: Houjou is a student who shares the same class as Takagi and Nishikata. She has a mature personality which contrasts with her classmates. Every time she sees someone immature, she would say how immature of them.
189581: Sumire Takagawa is one of Takagi's and Nishikata's classmates. She is a close friend of Takagi.
227379: Kyunko is the female protagonist in 100% Unrequited Love. This is a shōjo anime and manga series within the universe of Karakai Jōzu no Takagi-san. It is Nishikata favorite series and guilty pleasure.
